howToPlay: Colt is a long-range damage dealer who relies on precision. Utilize the Slick Boots Star Power to improve mobility or equip the Magnum Special to extend your reach. Choose between the Speedloader gadget to slow enemies or the Silver Bullet gadget to break walls and pierce targets.
gears: Equip the Reload Speed gear to maintain constant pressure and the Damage gear to capitalize on low health situations. The Shield or Health gears are also effective choices to increase survivability.
trait: This brawler suits players who enjoy high-skill aiming and maintaining distance from enemies.
